---
title: Assignments
---

```{r}
#| include: false
# Links and dates come from course-dates.json, never typed here.
source(here::here("course-dates.R"))

cal <- read_course_dates()
```

All assignment files for `r cal$label` are in one Google Drive folder:
**[download the course materials here](`r materials_url()`)**.
Open the folder for the assignment you need. Each one contains the `.qmd` to
work on and every dataset it uses.

Submit through the same form every time:
**[submission form](`r submission_url()`)**.
Submit both the `.qmd` and the rendered `.html`.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

for (n in 1:3) {
  id <- paste0("assignment-", n)
  cat(sprintf("\n## Assignment %d\n\n", n))
  cat(sprintf("1. Download the `%s/` folder from the [course materials](%s)\n",
              id, materials_url()))
  cat(sprintf("2. Work on **%s.qmd**, leaving all your R code and output in place\n", id))
  cat(sprintf("3. Submit the qmd and the html [here](%s)\n", submission_url()))
}
```

## Final project

Due **`r format_course_date('final-paper', '%A, %B %e')`**. Submit the qmd and
the html [here](`r submission_url()`).

Milestones: topic approved by
**`r format_course_date('final-project-topic', '%A, %B %e')`**; proposal due
